Index: docs/prototypes/new-game/T65/evidence/controls-zb9k3chj/script-input.py
===================================================================
--- docs/prototypes/new-game/T65/evidence/controls-zb9k3chj/script-input.py	
+++ docs/prototypes/new-game/T65/evidence/controls-zb9k3chj/script-input.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess,tempfile,json,hashlib,shutil,sys
+root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+repo=root.parents[3]
+out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="controls-",dir=root/"evidence"))
+sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+paths=[root/"borders.mjs",repo/"src/ui/referenceMapView.ts",root/"board.json",root/"map.svg",root/"preview.html"]
+original={p:p.read_bytes() for p in paths}
+for p,b in original.items():
+ dest=out/"originals"/p.relative_to(repo);dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_bytes(b)
+shutil.copy2(__file__,out/"script-input.py")
+layout=original[root/"borders.mjs"].decode()
+assert layout.count(" return result;")==1
+tail=lambda code:layout.replace(" return result;",code+"\n return result;")
+view=original[repo/"src/ui/referenceMapView.ts"].decode()
+cases=[
+ ("border-identity",root/"borders.mjs","export const naturalizeBorders=input=>structuredClone(input);\n","unit",False),
+ ("ignored-seed",root/"borders.mjs",layout.replace("seed=board.seed","seed=board.seed").replace("let hash=seed>>>0","let hash=1994>>>0"),"unit",False),
+ ("independent-country-noise",root/"borders.mjs",tail("result.provinces[0].polygon[8][0]+=1;"),"unit",False),
+ ("moved-coast",root/"borders.mjs",tail("result.islands[0].polygon[0][0]+=1;"),"unit",False),
+ ("moved-label",root/"borders.mjs",tail("result.provinces[0].labelAt[0]+=1;"),"unit",False),
+ ("old-painted-borders",repo/"src/ui/referenceMapView.ts",view.replace("T65/map.svg?raw","T64/map.svg?raw"),"playable",False),
+]
+rows=[]
+for name,p,mutant,kind,rebuild in cases:
+ if len(sys.argv)>1 and name not in sys.argv[1:]:continue
+ if p=="layout":p=root/"borders.mjs"
+ case=out/name;case.mkdir();(case/"mutated-source.txt").write_text(mutant)
+ row={"name":name,"path":str(p.relative_to(repo)),"originalSha256":sha(original[p]),"mutatedSha256":sha(mutant.encode())}
+ try:
+  p.write_text(mutant)
+  if rebuild:
+   generated=case/"regenerated"
+   with (case/"build.txt").open("wb") as log:build=subprocess.run(["node",str(root/"construct.mjs"),str(generated)],cwd=repo,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+   row["rebuildExit"]=build.returncode
+   if build.returncode:raise RuntimeError("Mutant did not regenerate; not a behavioral negative")
+   for asset_name in ["board.json","map.svg","preview.html"]:shutil.copy2(generated/asset_name,root/asset_name)
+  command=["python3",str(root/"checks.py"),"--focused"] if kind=="unit" else ["python3",str(root/"run.py")]+(["--grep","playable shared borders"] if kind=="playable" else [])
+  with (case/"output.txt").open("wb") as log:result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=repo,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+  row.update(command=command,exit=result.returncode)
+  text=(case/"output.txt").read_text();report=json.loads(text)
+  produced=repo/report["output"]
+  negative=(produced/"0.txt").read_text() if kind=="unit" else (produced/"raw/output.txt").read_text()
+  row["evidence"]=str(produced.relative_to(repo))
+  row["assertionNegative"]=result.returncode!=0 and any(token in negative for token in ["AssertionError","expect(received)","Expected:"])
+ except Exception as error:row.update(assertionNegative=False,error=repr(error))
+ finally:
+  for target,b in original.items():target.write_bytes(b)
+  row["restored"]=all(target.read_bytes()==b for target,b in original.items())
+  rows.append(row)
+  (out/"report.json").write_text(json.dumps({"cases":rows,"allRestored":all(r["restored"] for r in rows)},indent=2)+"\n")
+print(json.dumps({"output":str(out.relative_to(repo)),"cases":rows},indent=2))
+assert rows and all(r["assertionNegative"] and r["restored"] for r in rows)

1: // Canonical fixed-reference curves; no game rules or I/O. See CONTRACT.md.
2: import {pointSegmentGap} from '../T62/contract.mjs';
3: import {onSegment,distance,edges} from '../T24/geometry.mjs';
4: const point=p=>JSON.stringify(p),key=(a,b)=>[point(a),point(b)].sort().join('|');
5: const snap=p=>p.map(v=>Math.round(v*1024)/1024);
6: const smooth=t=>{t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
7: function canonical(board){
8:  const pieces=new Map(),rings=new Map();
9:  for(const p of board.provinces){
10:   const vertices=[...new Map(board.provinces.filter(q=>q.island===p.island).flatMap(q=>q.polygon).map(v=>[point(v),v])).values()];
11:   const ring=p.polygon.flatMap((a,j)=>{const b=p.polygon[(j+1)%p.polygon.length];return vertices.filter(v=>onSegment(v,a,b)&&distance(v,b)>1e-6).sort((u,v)=>distance(a,u)-distance(a,v));});
12:   rings.set(p.id,ring);
13:   for(const[a,b]of edges(ring)){
14:    const k=key(a,b);if(!pieces.has(k)){const ordered=point(a)<point(b)?[a,b]:[b,a];pieces.set(k,{a:ordered[0],b:ordered[1],owners:[]});}
15:    pieces.get(k).owners.push(p.id);
16:   }
17:  }
18:  return {pieces,rings};
19: }
20: export function naturalizeBorders(board,seed=board.seed){
21:  const maximum=5; // [designed] Retained amplitude/seed sweep and native-space mock: CONTRACT.md.
22:  const result=structuredClone(board),{pieces,rings}=canonical(board),all=[...pieces.values()],internal=all.filter(e=>e.owners.length===2),curves=new Map(),metrics=[];
23:  const pairs=new Set(internal.map(e=>[...e.owners].sort().join('|')));
24:  if(internal.length!==61||pairs.size!==61||all.some(e=>e.owners.length>2))throw Error('Unexpected reference shared-boundary structure');
25:  const ports=board.routes.flatMap(r=>[r.points[0],r.points.at(-1)]);
26:  const landings=board.routes.flatMap(r=>[[r.points[0],r.points[1]],[r.points.at(-1),r.points.at(-2)]]).map(([a,b])=>{const length=distance(a,b);return[a,[a[0]+12*(a[0]-b[0])/length,a[1]+12*(a[1]-b[1])/length]];});
27:  const rectGap=(p,c,hw,hh)=>Math.hypot(Math.max(0,Math.abs(p[0]-c[0])-hw),Math.max(0,Math.abs(p[1]-c[1])-hh));
28:  for(const e of internal){
29:   const length=distance(e.a,e.b),dx=(e.b[0]-e.a[0])/length,dy=(e.b[1]-e.a[1])/length;
30:   let hash=seed>>>0;for(const c of [...e.owners].sort().join('|'))hash=Math.imul(hash^c.charCodeAt(0),16777619)>>>0;
31:   const phase=(hash&65535)/65536*Math.PI*2,sign=hash>>>31?-1:1,amplitude=Math.min(maximum,length*.08),count=Math.max(4,Math.ceil(length/6));
32:   const countries=e.owners.map(id=>board.provinces.find(p=>p.id===id)),curve=[e.a];let largest=0,requested=0;
33:   for(let j=1;j<count;j++){
34:    const t=j/count,base=[e.a[0]+dx*length*t,e.a[1]+dy*length*t];
35:    const labelGap=Math.min(...countries.flatMap(p=>[rectGap(base,p.labelAt,22,24),rectGap(base,[p.labelAt[0]-21,p.labelAt[1]-14.5],5,7.5)]));
36:    let displacement=sign*amplitude*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*(.75+.25*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*t+phase))*smooth(labelGap/5);
37:    const otherGap=Math.min(...all.filter(other=>other!==e).map(other=>pointSegmentGap(base,other.a,other.b)));
38:    const portGap=Math.min(...ports.map(p=>Math.max(0,distance(base,p)-8)));
39:    const landingGap=Math.min(...landings.map(([a,b])=>pointSegmentGap(base,a,b)));
40:    const allowed=Math.min(labelGap*.75,otherGap*.2,portGap*.25,landingGap*.25);
41:    displacement=Math.sign(displacement)*Math.min(Math.abs(displacement),allowed);
42:    requested=Math.max(requested,Math.abs(displacement));
43:    const next=snap([base[0]-dy*displacement,base[1]+dx*displacement]);
44:    largest=Math.max(largest,pointSegmentGap(next,e.a,e.b));curve.push(next);
45:   }
46:   curve.push(e.b);const retained=requested<1/1024;curves.set(key(e.a,e.b),retained?[e.a,e.b]:curve);metrics.push({countries:e.owners,length,maxOffset:retained?0:largest,protectedStraight:retained});
47:  }
48:  for(const p of result.provinces)p.polygon=edges(rings.get(p.id)).flatMap(([a,b])=>{
49:   const curve=curves.get(key(a,b));if(!curve)return[a];
50:   const oriented=point(curve[0])===point(a)?curve:[...curve].reverse();return oriented.slice(0,-1);
51:  }).map(p=>[...p]);
52:  return result;
53: }
